description: Header file defining the BidirectionalStreamSpdyImpl class, which implements SPDY protocol stream handling with methods for starting streams, sending headers and data, reading data, and handling stream events. It is part of the net namespace and includes SPDY-specific stream management.

classes.name: BidirectionalStreamSpdyImpl
classes.description: Implements SPDY protocol bidirectional stream with methods for managing stream lifecycle, data transfer, and event handling within the net namespace.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the SPDY bidirectional stream with request info, logging, delegate, timer, and traffic annotation.

methods.name: SendRequestHeaders
methods.description: Sends the request headers over the SPDY stream.

methods.name: ReadData
methods.description: Reads data from the SPDY stream into the provided buffer.

methods.name: SendvData
methods.description: Sends multiple buffers of data over the SPDY stream, with an option to end the stream.

methods.name: GetProtocol
methods.description: Returns the negotiated protocol for the stream.

methods.name: GetTotalReceivedBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes received over the stream.

methods.name: GetTotalSentBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes sent over the stream.

methods.name: GetLoadTimingInfo
methods.description: Populates load timing information for the stream.

methods.name: PopulateNetErrorDetails
methods.description: Fills in network error details related to the stream.

methods.name: OnEarlyHintsReceived
methods.description: Called when early hints are received.

methods.name: OnHeadersReceived
methods.description: Called when response headers are received.

methods.name: OnDataReceived
methods.description: Called when data is received on the stream.

methods.name: OnDataSent
methods.description: Called when data has been sent.

methods.name: OnClose
methods.description: Called when the stream is closed with a status.

methods.name: CanGreaseFrameType
methods.description: Indicates if the stream can grease frame types.

methods.name: source_dependency
methods.description: Returns the source dependency for logging.
